Name: (CP) Als ZH Style Mayos
Author: Alleyballey28
Description:
Transforms mayonnaises from certain mods to look like they belong next to mayonnaises from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29535]ZH's Artisanal Goods series[/url]!
Also edits large sized mayo's shape to be more reminiscent of the smaller mayos
Just as configurable as ZH's mods!

Current compatibility
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24073]CiriunAlleyKitsu's Dodos Plus for 1.6[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43365]Pigeons Plus Revived[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36681]Waterside Flamingos (Barn Animals)[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18795]PFM Large Eggs Large Mayo[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20266](CP) Blue Eggs and Golden Mayo (Now with extra Ostrich)[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36021]Large Quail Mayonnaise[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43600]Em's Farm Goose and Geese﻿﻿﻿﻿[/url]﻿
[/list]
All mods are optional but obviously at least have one
To see the other visual styles (such as cover, tall bottle, etc) I suggest looking at ZH's artisanal goods series galleries.
Huge shoutout to Abagaianye and Kattia from the sdv discord, this mod wouldn't exist without their help!
